root_cause.summary: LinkedIn personal and company publishing shared one connected-account resolver. A token could prove the canonical member identity while lacking the organization ACL/write capability required by the company channel; auth-config scopes and ACTIVE/default metadata were therefore insufficient runtime truth.
causes: company create/readback inherited personal connected-account selection
organization capability was not proven on the exact connected account before company publication
provider auth metadata could diverge from the effective permissions of the connected token

prevention_rules: Resolve LinkedIn personal and LinkedIn company provider identities independently.
Require LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO plus LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO ADMINISTRATOR proof on the exact company connected account before consuming publication capability.
Persist every provider-created post/media ID immediately and set republish_forbidden=true.
When readback is unavailable, reconcile the exact provider ID instead of issuing a replacement.
Keep approved daily obligations open and self-heal the same claim until provider evidence exists or a genuine external authorization boundary is reached.
For Instagram, complete missing final Mira media inside the same daily obligation; never substitute generic company media.
Never use Buffer or Make as LinkedIn or Instagram publication fallback.

replay_scenarios.scenario: member token healthy but organization ACL missing
replay_scenarios.expected: company preflight rejects that token and continues probing active connections; personal channel remains independent

replay_scenarios.scenario: provider create returns a LinkedIn URN but exact readback is unavailable
replay_scenarios.expected: URN is persisted and the same claim enters reconciliation with republish_forbidden=true

replay_scenarios.scenario: Instagram daily claim has no final media
replay_scenarios.expected: same Mira claim resumes media production instead of silently expiring or falling back to generic media

outcome.intended_state: Every approved Amsterdam-day social obligation is terminally closed through provider evidence without duplicate side effects.
